name: Beriah
overview: Beriah is a male figure identified as a son of Ephraim, belonging to the tribe of Ephraim as noted in 1 Chronicles 7:23. Beyond his lineage, there are no additional details or notes provided about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Beriah is a proper name meaning "prominent, excellent." This meaning reflects a positive attribute but is not indicated as being given directly by God. The name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 7:23.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Beriah as a son of Ephraim. No other family relationships or descendants are documented beyond this direct paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Beriah's significance in Scripture is primarily genealogical, serving as a link in the lineage of the tribe of Ephraim. His mention in 1 Chronicles 7:23 helps preserve the genealogical history important for understanding Israel's tribal composition. Although the biblical record provides limited information about him, his inclusion underscores God's providential preservation of the family lines within Israel.
